spans.text: Formerly known as Yekaterina Vasilievna Petrovskaya.
In 2045, Petrovskaya was invited to join the Bureau of State Security, where she started operating under the alias Samantha Shaw [Attachment 295]...
In 2048, Shaw voted against a project during StateSec's annual project proposal meeting [Attachment 313]...

Yekaterina Vasilievna Petrovskaya has absolutely no patience for red tape, but she encountered issues during the vetting process. In order to successfully obtain a transfer order to participate in a confidential project, her superiors followed orders from above to arrange a flamboyant false identity for her, but she refused to comply.
In the end, with her protests falling on deaf ears, Yekaterina Vasilievna adopted "Samantha Shaw" as her codename, or S.S. for short, which also stands for "Special Standard."
2048 Key Scientific Research Project Prososal Meeting.
Reason for rejection—the technical risks are too great. Ms. Samantha Shaw has submitted an alternative proposal.
